notes: The catalogue tentatively identifies 'Yaśodhara vajrācāya?' as the scribe, but 'śrījaśodharavihāra' refers to the monastery (Śrī Yaśodhara-vihāra / Bū Bāhā in Patan) where the scribe lived ('śrījaśodharavihāravāsitaḥ'). The actual personal name of the vajrācārya scribe following 'vrajācāryye(ṇa)' is lost in a lacuna ('……..').
